Hello Ivan,

I'm reaching out regarding the Quality Assurance Engineer role at MentorMate you have applied for. 

I want to let you know that unfortunately,  we don't have an available project to offer you right now.

However, we are impressed with your profile and professional experience and we would like to continue considering you for future opportunities within our company, so we might be reaching out in the following weeks.

*In the meantime, we kindly request your consent to extend the retention and processing period of your data for up to 3 years. You can provide your consent by using the following link:* https://jobs.lever.co/mentormate/m/2ed981b2-9027-4841-aa99-317549442580. 

At MentorMate, we value your privacy and strive to provide a secure and reliable experience throughout our recruitment process. By complying with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), we ensure that your personal information is handled with the utmost care and protection, in alignment with our Candidate Privacy Notice. 

I would be happy to stay in touch and talk to you once again. Looking forward to meeting with you in the future!

Best, 

Nara Mongelos

Talent Acquisition Team

En el apartado de "Duración y División de la Jornada" se menciona que el horario de trabajo diurno será de 48 horas semanales. Sin embargo, al especificar la división estimativa de la jornada de trabajo, se menciona que el horario sería de lunes a viernes desde las 09:00 a 18:00 horas, con un periodo de descanso de 12:00 a 13:00 horas. Si calculo las horas diarias (9:00 a 18:00), resultan en un total de 8 horas diarias, lo que sumaría 40 horas semanales (considerando el horario de 5 días a la semana).

Me gustaría solicitar una aclaración sobre las horas semanales de trabajo que se esperan, ya que en un lugar menciona 48 horas y en otro lugar parece que la jornada es de 40 horas semanales. ¿Podrías confirmar cuál es el número de horas semanales de trabajo que se aplicará según el contrato?
